instruction.name: vmulwev.h.bu
instruction.description: Multiply the even-positioned unsigned 8-bit elements in `a` and the corresponding unsigned 8-bit elements in `b`, extending both to 16-bit, and save the 16-bit result in `dst`.

throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 3.99 cycles. The measured CPI 0.4988 is the nominal 0.5 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LSX widening/narrowing integer instruction. Measured on LA664 with positive integer operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000). Both vector sources are recorded separately; they share the same result path where the hardware is symmetric.
